summary_from_search.q1_results: Q1 net income $1.7B (+5% YoY); EPS $2.87 (+6% YoY); record Q1 strength. Stock rallied to 52-week high post-earnings.
summary_from_search.guidance: Management reiterated 2026 mid-single-digit reported EPS growth and continued operating-ratio gains (including merger costs); 3-year EPS CAGR target high single-digit to low double-digit through 2027.
summary_from_search.catalysts: Merger approval (NSC deal, $85B) and fuel trends are next key catalysts. Regulatory scrutiny from STB and state AGs ongoing.
summary_from_search.headwinds: Fuel-driven margin pressure, intermodal softness, merger uncertainty.
